finding: WAVE2B (2026-10-01) re-run: printed 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.' With a discardable card in hand (a real Shock, decision word supplied) the cast succeeds but the hand is UNTOUCHED — no discard cost is collected; Shock sits in hand after Masticore resolves.
